I need to recall the design of the Liberian flag.

The flag of Liberia closely resembles the American flag and was adopted when Liberia was founded by freed American slaves. The Liberian flag has:
- 11 alternating red and white stripes (representing the 11 signatories of the Liberian Declaration of Independence)
- A blue square in the upper left corner (canton)
- A single white five-pointed star in the blue canton (representing Liberia as the first independent republic in Africa)

Agent 1's answer of 1 star with confidence 0.92 is correct. The Liberian flag has exactly one star.

Answer: 1
Confidence: 0.98
